name: britomartis-of-consent
description: Britomartis of Consent: an MCP agent that inventories the cookies and third-party scripts a site actually sets and loads (from exported HTML and browser HAR captures), compares them with your stated cookie policy and banner, and reports the gaps: undeclared cookies, trackers before consent or after a reject, contradicted 'no cookies' claims. Publishing a policy or banner change is a production deploy: always one human click. Not a consent-management platform and never claims GDPR, CCPA or ePrivacy compliance.
author: Kurt Francisco
